why: The Treasury cash card now states its reserve effect, which the golden page does not.
pairs: When this balance rises, Treasury is pulling cash into its own account and bank reserves fall. When it falls, Treasury is spending it down and reserves rise.
余额上升时，财政部把现金抽入自有账户，银行准备金随之减少；余额下降时，财政部花出这笔现金，银行准备金随之增加。
